auditors.auditor: الجهاز المركزي للرقابة المالية (Central Organization for Financial Control)
auditors.year: standing statutory mandate under Basic Monetary Law No. 23 of 2002; the law states no financial year
auditors.source_title: قانون النقد الأساسي رقم 23 للعام 2002 (Basic Monetary Law No. 23 of 2002), article 68(3), official text published by the Central Bank of Syria on its own legislation page cb.gov.sy/en/legislation/1232. This is Syria's supreme audit institution acting as the Central Bank's statutory auditor, not a private firm; no private firm is named, and the Central Bank's own Business Report 2019 carries no independent auditor's report.
auditors.quote: يدقق الجهاز المركزي للرقابة المالية قيود مصرف سورية المركزي وحساباته في حدود أحكام قانونه

auditors.auditor: the Board of the National Bank of Cambodia and the National Audit Authority
auditors.year: standing statutory mandate since the amending law of 29 December 2006; the law states no financial year
auditors.source_title: Law on Amendment Article 14 and Article 57 of the Law on the Organization and Function of the National Bank of Cambodia, 29 December 2006, article 57-New, printed in the NBC's own compilation 'Laws and Regulations Applicable to Banks and Financial Institutions'. The National Audit Authority is Cambodia's supreme audit institution; the statute names no private firm, and the NBC's annual reports (2022 English, 2025 Khmer, pages 15-154 of which are image-only scans that were OCRed) carry no independent auditor's report.
auditors.quote: The financial records of the Central Bank shall be verified by the Board of the National Bank of Cambodia and the National Audit Authority.

not_found.note: Bank of the Lao PDR. bol.gov.la is unreachable from this sandbox (curl: connection reset through the agent proxy, five retries on https://www.bol.gov.la/ and /en/annualReport) and WebFetch refuses it as robots_disallowed, so neither the bank's annual report index nor any BOL financial statements could be opened. Statute route instead: the Lao official gazette (laoofficialgazette.gov.la, which is reachable by curl) publishes 'Banking of Lao PDR Law .pdf' (https://laoofficialgazette.gov.la/kcfinder/upload/files/Banking%20of%20Lao%20PDR%20Law%20.pdf), 21 pages, Lao script, which extracts cleanly with pdftotext once Lao combining marks are normalised. Chapter 6, article 20 (ການກວດກາບັນຊີ) says the BOL's year-end accounts must be audited by an internal audit committee of the BOL, by an accounts-audit committee from the Ministry of Finance appointed by the Government, or by an auditor taken from outside; article 21 adds a government inspector appointed and removed by the Prime Minister. That is three alternatives, not one appointed auditor, so nothing was filed under the refusal rule on mechanisms. This text is also the older (No. 29) law, not the 2018 amended Law on the Bank of the Lao PDR, which the gazette did not surface. Untried: an English translation of the 2018 amended BOL law (ftp.laotradeportal.gov.la hosts Legal_*.pdf files and laotradeportal.gov.la is reachable by curl), and the Lao State Audit Organisation's own reports.

National Bank of the Republic of Belarus. nbrb.by is unreachable from this sandbox: https://www.nbrb.by/engl/publications/report/, https://www.nbrb.by/publications/report, https://nbrb.by/ and the www form all fail with connection reset / empty reply through the agent proxy (five retries each, plus HTTP/1.1 and non-www variants), and WebFetch refuses https://www.nbrb.by/publications/report as robots_disallowed, so the annual report PDF that would carry the audit conclusion was never opened. Alternatives tried: pravo.by, etalonline.by and president.gov.by are all reachable by curl, but pravo.by's site search is JavaScript-driven and returned no document list, and the pravo.by news item on the 2019 report (https://pravo.by/novosti/novosti-pravo-by/2020/may/50324/) was read in full - it records that Presidential Decree No. 164 of 13 May 2020 approved the National Bank's 2019 report including its annual accounting (financial) statements, and names no audit organisation. etalonline.by/dokumenty/bankovskiy-kodeks/ returns 404. web.archive.org is also unreachable from this sandbox, so no archived copy of the nbrb.by report could be fetched. Untried: the Banking Code article on the National Bank's audit (to confirm the mechanism), and the annual presidential act determining the audit organisation, which would have to be found through etalonline.by's own document IDs.

Centrale Bank van Curacao en Sint Maarten. A readable annual report PDF was located this round but could not be opened: https://cdn.centralbank.cw/media/annual_report_2023/20241221_cbcs_jaarverslag_2023.pdf (CBCS Jaarverslag 2023, which search results describe as containing a controleverklaring/report of the independent auditor). cdn.centralbank.cw and www.centralbank.cw both answer 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment... Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue' interstitial to curl, and WebFetch returns client_error on both the CDN PDF and https://www.centralbank.cw/annual-reports. The older document host exch.centralbank.cw is unreachable by curl (connection reset) and WebFetch refuses it as robots_disallowed, so https://exch.centralbank.cw/publications/annual-reports-quarterly-bulletins/2017 (and the 2016, 2018, 2021 equivalents) could not be read either. THIS ONE NEEDS A BROWSER, NOT A BETTER SEARCH: the exact PDF URL above should yield the auditor's name to anyone who can pass a Cloudflare JavaScript check. Also unread for the same reason: the 2024 and 2025 annual reports, which press releases on smn-news.com say were published; and the Curacao Landscourant on gobiernu.cw, which answered 429 when probed and publishes only CBCS condensed balance sheets.

Banky Foiben'i Madagasikara. banky-foibe.mg is unreachable from this sandbox (curl: connection reset on https://www.banky-foibe.mg/, the non-www form, /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt, five retries) and WebFetch refuses https://www.banky-foibe.mg/ as robots_disallowed, so the bank's own publications index and any Rapport annuel or etats financiers on it were never reached. Two French searches for the Rapport annuel, commissaire aux comptes and auditeur externe returned only Madagascan commercial banks (BNI, BOA/Bank of Africa Madagascar) and an unrelated BCMM mining audit, repeating the earlier rounds' result. www.imf.org answers 403 to curl, droit-afrique.com answers 403, natlex.ilo.org answers 403 and web.archive.org is unreachable, so the IMF staff-report and third-party-mirror routes were closed too. The statute position from the earlier round stands and was not re-tested: Loi n 2016-004, articles 73, 76 and 85, provide for an external auditor appointed by the Board on the Audit Committee's proposal and name no firm or body. Untried: elibrary.imf.org, which is reachable by curl (its /search endpoint returned HTTP 202 with an empty body on a plain GET, so it needs its real query API), and documents1.worldbank.org, also reachable.

Palestine Monetary Authority. Settled negatively on the statute; no firm is named anywhere readable. www.pma.ps is reachable by curl but is a JavaScript single-page application: the homepage, https://www.pma.ps/publications/annual-reports and every /api/... path guessed (api/publications, api/publications/annual-reports, api/v1/publications, en/api/publications) all return the same 6,300-byte HTML shell, and WebFetch on https://www.pma.ps/en/Publications/AnnualReports returned only the page's metadata. robots.txt allows everything and sitemap.xml (394 URLs) lists /publications/annual-reports but no PDF file paths, so no annual report PDF URL exists to download. Statute route, read in full on maqam.najah.edu (An-Najah University's Palestinian legislation encyclopaedia, reachable by curl): article 66 of Law No. 2 of 1997 on the Palestine Monetary Authority requires the PMA to give the President and the Cabinet, within three months of year end, 'نسخة عن بياناتها المالية المعتمدة من المدققين الخارجيين المعتمدين' - a copy of its financial statements certified by accredited external auditors - and names no firm; articles 65 and 67 cover the financial year, IAS accounting and the annual report, and name no auditor either. Decision No. 108 of 2011 on the PMA's financial and accounting regulation (maqam.najah.edu/legislation/398/) was also read: it has the Governor send the annual financial statements to 'مدقق الحسابات الخارجي' for audit before Board approval by end of March, and provides for 'أتعاب مدققي الحسابات الخارجين وفق العقد المبرم معهم' (the external auditors' fees under their contract), again with no firm named. So: a mechanism, not a record. Untried: a PMA procurement award for the audit contract, and the printed PMA annual report distributed through info.wafa.ps.

Banco Central de Venezuela. bcv.org.ve is unreachable from this sandbox (curl: connection reset on https://www.bcv.org.ve/, the non-www form and /estadisticas; WebFetch refuses https://www.bcv.org.ve/estadisticas/estados-financieros as robots_disallowed), so the BCV's own half-year financial statements and notes PDFs - the files search surfaces as bcv.org.ve/system/files/estados_financieros/notas_estados_financieros_al_31.12.2011.pdf and similar - could not be opened. Mirror hunting failed: tsj.gob.ve is unreachable; faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/ven127129.pdf turned out to be a 2012 Gaceta Oficial extract on the internal-audit unit of the Ministry of Tourism, with no mention of the Banco Central; bolsadecaracas.com's Gaceta_39546.pdf (5 November 2010) is the Securities Market Law correction, which mentions the BCV only as a monthly reporter to the securities regulator; leybook.com/doc/10496/pdf is Nicaragua's 1980 Comptroller General law, not Venezuelan. The Ley Organica de la Administracion Financiera del Sector Publico (read in full from archivo.provea.org) sets up the Superintendencia Nacional de Auditoria Interna as the internal-control organ and the Contraloria General de la Republica as the external-control organ for the public sector generally, and says nothing about the Banco Central specifically, so it is not a record of who audits the BCV's accounts. No text of the Ley del Banco Central de Venezuela itself was obtained. The April 2026 press coverage of US- and Venezuela-commissioned firms reviewing Venezuelan assets abroad remains a one-off review, not the statutory audit.

Central Bank of Turkmenistan. Settled negatively on the bank's own primary text. cbt.tm is reachable by curl (with retries - it resets at random). The site is static HTML with no annual report, no financial statements and no publications index: /en/ and /en/laws/laws.html list only three laws. The official English text of the Law on the Central Bank of Turkmenistan was downloaded and read in full (https://www.cbt.tm/en/laws/tmb_hakynda_kanun.html, 58,518 characters). Chapter 11 covers accounting, reporting and auditing; article 51 has the bank submit its annual report to the President three months after year end, and article 53(1) says 'President of Turkmenistan shall designate an independent auditing organization that will perform the external audit of the annual financial report of Central Bank of Turkmenistan', with article 53(2) putting internal audit in the bank's own auditing service. That is a mechanism and names no firm, so nothing was filed - the same position as Egypt's article 36. The bank publishes no audited accounts at all, so the firm the President designates is not discoverable from the bank's own site.

Central Bank of Uzbekistan. Settled negatively, and the untried leads from the earlier round were tried and closed. cbu.uz is reachable by curl. The Russian-language publications index (https://cbu.uz/ru/publications/annual-report/) was opened and the 2025 annual report downloaded (https://cbu.uz/upload/medialibrary/ded/k3lrh194iz4934w1hzgsdw3obmrrdvn0/Godovoy-otchet-2025.pdf, 205 pages, 655,857 characters of clean extracted text), together with the 2023 report (190 pages). Neither contains financial statements or an auditor's report: the 2025 contents end at section IX 'Приложения' after a chapter on personnel and internal control, every one of the roughly forty 'аудит' hits is internal audit (section 8.6, the Служба внутреннего аудита, the GIAS standards, the risk-based internal audit plan for 2025-2027, remote audit of territorial departments), PwC appears only as a glossary entry for the abbreviation and KPMG only as an adviser on data governance and ADR reporting. The bank's own site search was run for 'внешний аудит финансовой отчетности', 'аудиторская организация', KPMG, Deloitte, Ernst and PricewaterhouseCoopers: the only audit-of-the-Central-Bank hit is a tender notice, 'Конкурс на проведение аудита финансовой отчетности Центрального банка по итогам 2015 года' (cbu.uz/ru/press_center/adverts/39469/), which is a call for bids and names no winner; every big-four hit is a seminar or forum. The public-procurement page carries no audit award. So article 8 of the 2019 Central Bank law still names a mechanism and no firm, and no award document naming one exists on the bank's own site. Untried: xarid.uzex.uz procurement awards, and the Senate of the Oliy Majlis's own record of the audit conclusion it receives.
